name: flaggems_batch_norm_impl_index
description: Batch Normalization internal dispatch (output, save_mean, save_invstd, reserve, impl_index) used by the JIT to keep backend selection.
reference:
import torch

def run(input, weight, bias, running_mean, running_var, training, momentum, eps, cudnn_enabled):
    rm = running_mean.clone() if running_mean is not None else None
    rv = running_var.clone() if running_var is not None else None
    return torch.ops.aten._batch_norm_impl_index(
        input, weight, bias, rm, rv, bool(training), float(momentum), float(eps), bool(cudnn_enabled))

def gen_inputs(ctx, device):
    x_shape = ctx['input__shape']
    x_dtype = ctx['input__dtype']
    dtype = getattr(torch, x_dtype)
    C = x_shape[1]
    input = torch.randn(*x_shape, device=device, dtype=dtype)
    weight = torch.randn(C, device=device, dtype=dtype)
    bias = torch.randn(C, device=device, dtype=dtype)
    running_mean = torch.zeros(C, device=device, dtype=dtype)
    running_var = torch.ones(C, device=device, dtype=dtype)
    return {
        'input': input,
        'weight': weight,
        'bias': bias,
        'running_mean': running_mean,
        'running_var': running_var,
    }
